title: wave-settings-dialog: the overall-wave gear moves from the track graphics area into the group's title bar (GT11.10 fold header); it opens a NEW two-pane dialog — narrow tab list left («Оба канала» / «Левый» / «Правый»), wide settings pane centre — settings apply per the active tab

decisions.text: ONE gear per group, in the title bar (owner req 1). Today SF27 puts a per-track gear inside EACH overall-wave track's graphics area (WaveformView.vue:35-45), so stereo shows two gears each opening its channel's dialog (TracksPanel.vue:402). Replaced by a single settings button at the right edge of the GT11.10 fold header «Общая волна» (TracksPanel.vue:348-380) — the title's flex:1 pushes it right; @click.stop so the header's fold/Ctrl-click behaviour is untouched. Opens the dialog on the «Оба канала» tab; per-channel access is via the tabs (req 5).

Dialog shape mirrors the GT10.29 precedent (AudioPage.vue:49-86): q-card -> row no-wrap -> narrow q-list (~160px, clickable items + active-class) + q-separator vertical + wide content pane; own CSS classes tracks-panel__wf-settings-*. Stays INLINE in TracksPanel like every other TracksPanel dialog (SF26 minimap, gtrack settings, the old SF27 one): the per-channel state and its localStorage persistence live there, and extracting a component for three controls would only add props/emits plumbing.

REVISED 2026-07-15 (owner req 6: «На форме "Оба канала" нужен тоггл - Применить к обоим каналам. Если он включен, то пункты слева "Левый" и "Правый" становятся недоступны»). State: waveformSettingsOpen: boolean + waveformSettingsTab: 'both' | 0 | 1 (replaces the channel|null open-flag trick at TracksPanel.vue:1850-1860) + waveformLinkChannels: boolean, persisted (WS-D7), default ON. The toggle lives ON the «Оба канала» form, above the settings. Semantics: (a) ON (default) -> the «Оба канала» controls are live and wfDlg* set writes BOTH channels; the «Левый»/«Правый» items are :disable (req 6 verbatim). (b) OFF -> «Левый»/«Правый» are enabled and edit their own channel; the «Оба канала» CONTROLS are disabled (only the toggle stays live) — otherwise the form would contradict its own label, writing to both while 'apply to both' is off. (c) Flipping the toggle NEVER changes values — it only locks/unlocks the tabs; levelling happens solely when the user edits a control on the «Оба канала» form, so a stray toggle click is not destructive (this dialog has no undo for any setting). (d) get on «Оба канала» reads channel 0: with diverged channels (the defaults diverge BY DESIGN — L cyan / R amber, §2.4) the form shows the left channel's value until the first edit levels both; native input type=color has no mixed state, so no 'values differ' indicator is built. The toggle's DEFAULT (ON) is the one open owner question at the WS1.3 PAUSE — see R1. REPLACED: the earlier 'both shows left, no indicator' question, which the owner answered with this toggle instead.

REVISED 2026-07-15 (owner req 7: «Моно-файл - один пукт "Моно"»). Mono (isSpectrogramStereo === false, one physical channel): the left list collapses to a SINGLE item labelled «Моно» — the internal tab id stays 'both' (it means the single/all-channels scope; only the label changes), «Левый»/«Правый» are hidden, and the WS-D3 toggle is HIDDEN too ('apply to both channels' is meaningless with one channel). The form edits channel 0.

Overlay mode and gtrack lanes DO NOT move. In overlay the overall-wave stack (and thus its title bar) is not rendered at all — the waveform is drawn over the spectrogram, and SpectrogramView's own gear (visible when waveformOverlay, SpectrogramView.vue:86-92) opens the waveform settings for its channel (TracksPanel.vue:494). That gear stays in place and now opens the NEW dialog preselected on its channel's tab. REVISED 2026-07-15 (req 6): when waveformLinkChannels is ON the per-channel tab is LOCKED, so every per-channel entry point must fall back to «Оба канала» rather than land on a disabled tab — one rule: openWaveformSettings(ch) -> tab = link ? 'both' : ch (applies to the spectrogram overlay gear and, until WS1.2 removes them, the per-track gears too). Gtrack lane gears (per-lane GTrackSpectrumSettings via gtrackSettingsId, TracksPanel.vue:298/254) are untouched.

WaveformView gains prop showSettingsGear with withDefaults default TRUE — NOT a bare type-only boolean (an absent boolean prop casts to false, the known Vue pitfall): lanes pass nothing and keep their gear (it opens per-lane settings), the overall stack passes :show-settings-gear="false". The open-settings emit stays. Mirrors the GT10.3 precedent (SpectrogramView.showSettingsGear:213-214), same prop name, inverted default.

The settings SET is unchanged: colour / amplitude scale lin-dB / overlay opacity (the latter, as today, visible only when viewMode === 'overlay'). Persistence keeps the same localStorage key 'mindwave-tracks-waveform' (TracksPanel.vue:1794,1820-1849,2215-2226) and gains exactly ONE new field — link: boolean (WS-D3) — which is backward compatible: absent -> default. The dialog is a new shell around the same wfDlg* accessors; no value migration.

i18n (ru+en): new key audio.waveformSettingsTitle («Настройки отображения волны» / "Waveform display settings") for the dialog title and the new header button's tooltip/aria; tab keys audio.waveformChannelsBoth/Left/Right («Оба канала» / «Левый» / «Правый», en "Both channels" / "Left" / "Right"); audio.waveformChannelMono («Моно» / "Mono", req 7); audio.waveformApplyBoth («Применить к обоим каналам» / "Apply to both channels", req 6). The owner wrote «Обе канала» and CONFIRMED «Оба канала» 2026-07-15 (req 8) -> R6 closed. Existing audio.waveformStyle stays — the lane gears in WaveformView still use it.

steps.title: Новый двухпанельный диалог настроек волны (вкладки «Оба канала»/«Левый»/«Правый» + тоггл «Применить к обоим каналам») на месте SF27-диалога + i18n; открывается пока из старых гиров (гир канала → вкладка канала, при link=ON → «Оба канала»)
steps.verify: bun run typecheck + bun run build (MindWaveCore/ui); bun test ui server (GnauralCore) зелёные; manual (стерео): тоггл ON — «Левый»/«Правый» недоступны (req 6), правка на «Оба канала» меняет ОБА канала; тоггл OFF — Л/П доступны и правят только свой канал, контролы формы «Оба канала» выключены; флип тоггла сам по себе значений не меняет; гир канала при ON открывает «Оба канала», при OFF — свою вкладку (WS-D5); overlay — слайдер прозрачности виден только там; mono — один пункт «Моно», тоггла нет; закрыть/открыть — значения И состояние тоггла персистятся (localStorage +link, WS-D7)
evidence: Commit 0aaf88a (GnauralCore). Owner approved the WS-D3 default (toggle ON) 2026-07-15 -> implemented as specified; the whole scope model landed in one step because the tab list, the toggle and the wfDlg* accessors are one mechanism (a half-migrated dialog would have been a worse checkpoint than none).

A REAL BUG caught by reading Quasar's source instead of trusting :disable — and it would have broken req 6 outright. QItem.js does NOT set inheritAttrs:false, so a fallthrough @click lands on the root element and Vue runs it ALONGSIDE QItem's own handler; QItem's internal onClick no-ops when disabled (QItem.js:98-99 guards on isClickable), but mine would still have fired. Quasar's `.disabled` rule (css/core/visibility.sass:30-36) only sets outline/cursor/opacity — NOT pointer-events — so the click does reach the element. Net effect without a guard: a LOCKED «Левый»/«Правый» tab still opens on click, i.e. exactly what req 6 forbids, while looking disabled. Fixed with our own guard (selectWaveformSettingsTab returns early). Lesson for this codebase: a Quasar `:disable` dims and drops the component's OWN handling; it does not neutralise a listener you attached.

Mono is not just a label change (WS-D4): 'both' there writes ONLY channel 0. Writing ch 1 as well would have silently overwritten the stored R preference (the arrays are always length 2 and persist), so editing colour on a MONO file would have changed R for the next STEREO file opened — a cross-file data effect with no UI to reveal it. wfDlgTargets() encodes 'every channel that EXISTS', not 'both slots'.

R4 guard implemented as a watch on [isSpectrogramStereo, waveformLinkChannels]: a scope of 0/1 is coerced back to 'both' if the file turns mono under an open dialog, or if the tab it points at gets locked. Keeps the invariant 'a locked/nonexistent tab is never the active one' true by construction rather than by UI convention.
Verify run: vue-tsc --noEmit 0 errors; quasar build ok; GnauralCore bun test ui server 252 pass / 0 fail (850 expect()).

Checked what the BUILD cannot catch (a missing i18n key renders as the key string at runtime, silently): a script resolved every t('audio.*') key used by the dialog against BOTH locales — all 6 new keys present in ru+en, and the whole-file sweep found 0 broken keys across 84. Bundle audit: all 5 tracks-panel__wf-settings* rules present in assets/TracksPanel-Cq8da1pU.css, «Применить к обоим каналам» present in the emitted JS.

NOT verified by me: the visual/interaction pass — no browser driver exists anywhere in the workspace (checked), and installing Playwright + Chromium into the owner's actively-running dev environment for one dialog was not proportionate. That check is WS1.3, which is an owner PAUSE by design. What IS confirmed live: the owner's dev server (Mode=dev, quasar dev on 9000 per server/app.cfg) serves the updated module — 9 new-code markers incl. selectWaveformSettingsTab/waveformLinkChannels — so the running app has the change via HMR.

steps.title: Перенос шестерёнки в тайтл-бар «Общая волна»: кнопка в fold-хедере (открывает «Оба канала») + prop showSettingsGear в WaveformView (false в overall-стеке)
steps.verify: typecheck + build; bun test ui server; manual: в области графики дорожек общей волны шестерёнок НЕТ, в тайтл-баре ЕСТЬ (открывает вкладку «Оба канала»); гиры лейнов gtrack на месте и открывают per-lane настройки; overlay-гир спектрограммы открывает новый диалог (при link=ON — на «Оба канала», WS-D5); fold/eye/Ctrl-click хедера не сломаны
evidence: Commit 58f551f (GnauralCore). The header needed NO CSS surgery, as surveyed: the title's flex:1 (tracks-panel__gtrack-header-title) pushes a trailing button to the right edge; the new class only joins the existing `flex: 0 0 auto` rule beside the fold/eye buttons, which are already size=xs in the same 22px bar (R3 closed — nothing clipped, and the tooltip teleports so the header's overflow:hidden cannot cut it).

The gear could not be DELETED from WaveformView (the constraint the plan found before writing code): the gtrack solo sub-lanes reuse the component and their gear opens per-lane settings. Hence WS-D6's prop with withDefaults default true — a bare type-only boolean would cast the absent prop to false and silently strip the lanes' gear (the known Vue pitfall).

Wiring audited by grep rather than assumed, since a stale listener typechecks fine: the overall waveform-view now carries :show-settings-gear=false and its @open-settings listener is GONE (it had become unreachable — the gear was the only emitter). Remaining open-settings listeners are exactly the intended four: 3 gtrack lane ones (GTrackView + solo wave + solo spectrum -> gtrackSettingsId) and the overall SPECTROGRAM's openWaveformSettings(channel), which is the overlay entry point (WS-D5).

@click without .stop matches the neighbouring fold/eye buttons: the header div itself has no click handler — PW5.8's Ctrl-click hide lives on the per-track EYE (onOverallChannelHide via @hide), not on the bar — so there is nothing to stop.
Verify run: vue-tsc --noEmit 0 errors; quasar build ok; GnauralCore bun test ui server 252 pass / 0 fail. Bundle: the tracks-panel__gtrack-header-gear rule is present in the emitted CSS.

Note for the reviewer: WaveformView.vue moved under me mid-step — commit 1016af4 (TT2.10, the readout tooltip) landed during this session. Diff re-read before staging: it touches the readout, not the gear; my working diff contains only my lines.

evidence: ЧТО ПРОВЕРИТЬ: (1) req 1 — в области графики дорожек «Общей волны» шестерёнок больше НЕТ, одна в тайтл-баре справа; (2) req 2-4 — диалог: узкий список слева, широкая панель настроек по центру; (3) req 5-6 — тоггл «Применить к обоим каналам» ON (дефолт): «Левый»/«Правый» недоступны, правка цвета/шкалы меняет ОБА канала; выключить тоггл: Л/П становятся доступны и правят только свой канал, а контролы формы «Оба канала» гаснут (у неё больше нет своей области действия); (4) сам флип тоггла значений не меняет — только запирает/отпирает вкладки; (5) req 7 — моно-файл: один пункт «Моно», тоггла нет; (6) не сломано: гиры лейнов gtrack открывают per-lane настройки, режим overlay — гир на спектрограмме открывает этот диалог (при ON — на «Оба канала»), fold/eye/Ctrl-click хедера работают; (7) закрыть/открыть — значения и состояние тоггла сохраняются.

ОСОЗНАННОЕ СЛЕДСТВИЕ ДЕФОЛТА ON (R1), стоит увидеть вживую: цвета каналов по умолчанию расходятся намеренно (SF27: L cyan / R amber). При тоггле ON первая же правка цвета сделает оба канала одноцветными, и различение L/R на глаз пропадёт; вернуть можно, выключив тоггл и задав цвета по вкладкам. Если это мешает — дефолт OFF меняется одной строкой (ценой: вкладка по умолчанию открывается с выключенными контролами).
ОТКРЫТЫЙ ВОПРОС: чистить ли мёртвый дубликат waveform-state в AudioPage (WS2.1, side-find §2.6) — сегодня безвреден, но пишет в тот же ключ localStorage.

ЗАКРЫТО ответами владельца 2026-07-15: индикация расхождения L/R -> заменена тогглом (req 6); mono -> «Моно» (req 7); «Оба канала» (req 8); дефолт тоггла ON -> подтверждён владельцем перед реализацией.

log.text:
Phase 1 code done, parked at the WS1.3 PAUSE. WS1.1 (0aaf88a): the two-pane dialog + the link toggle + i18n. WS1.2 (58f551f): the gear moved to the title bar + showSettingsGear. Owner approved the toggle default (ON) before implementation, so nothing was guessed. vue-tsc 0, quasar build ok, GnauralCore bun test ui server 252/252.

The one defect found was found by reading Quasar's source, not by running anything — and it would have defeated the owner's requirement while LOOKING right: QItem does not set inheritAttrs:false, so my @click fell through onto the root element and Vue ran it beside QItem's own guarded handler, while Quasar's `.disabled` rule sets no pointer-events. A 'disabled' «Левый» tab would have opened on click. Guard is now ours. Generalisable for this codebase: Quasar's :disable dims the control and drops the component's OWN handling — it does not neutralise a listener you attached to it.

Two things the requirement did not mention but the data did: (1) mono's 'both' writes ONLY channel 0 — writing the second slot too would have let a mono-file edit silently rewrite the R preference that the next STEREO file loads (the arrays are length 2 and persist); (2) an R4 watch coerces the scope off a channel tab that stops existing (stereo->mono) or gets locked, so 'a locked/absent tab is never active' holds by construction.

Verification honesty: the visual/interaction pass is NOT done — no browser driver exists in the workspace and installing Playwright+Chromium into the owner's live dev environment for one dialog was not proportionate; that pass is WS1.3, an owner checkpoint by design. What automation CAN cover was covered, including the failure the build cannot see: a missing i18n key renders as the key string at runtime, so every t('audio.*') key was resolved against BOTH locales (6 new ones present; 0 broken across 84). Confirmed the change is live for the owner: their dev server (Mode=dev, quasar dev on 9000) already serves the updated module via HMR.

Owner answered all three plan questions (reqs 6-8), BEFORE any code was written — the plan changed, not a shipped UI. (1) req 6: «Оба канала» gets a toggle «Применить к обоим каналам»; when ON the «Левый»/«Правый» items go unavailable. This REPLACES my question about indicating L/R divergence: the owner's answer is not an indicator but a MODE. (2) req 7: mono -> a single «Моно» item (my WS-D4 proposed reusing the «Оба канала» label; the owner picked the alternative I had offered). (3) req 8: «Оба канала» confirmed -> R6 closed.

What the toggle forced me to settle, since the owner specified only its ON effect (tabs disabled): (a) what the «Оба канала» form does when the toggle is OFF -> its CONTROLS are disabled (only the toggle stays live), because a form that writes both channels while 'apply to both' is off would contradict its own label; the cost is that the default tab opens 'dead' when the toggle is OFF, which is precisely why the toggle's default is proposed ON. (b) Whether flipping the toggle LEVELS the channels -> no: the flip only locks/unlocks tabs, values move only on a real edit. Levelling-on-flip would make an accidental click destroy R's colour with no undo, and it is not needed for the label to stay truthful ('apply to both' is a promise about edits, not a claim that the channels are already identical). (c) A knock-on the requirement did not mention (WS-D5): with the toggle ON, a per-channel entry point (the overlay spectrogram gear) would land on a DISABLED tab -> one rule, openWaveformSettings(ch) -> tab = link ? 'both' : ch.

The one judgement left for the PAUSE is the toggle's DEFAULT. Proposed ON, but it is not free: the per-channel defaults diverge BY DESIGN (SF27's L cyan #67e8f9 / R amber #fbbf24), so with ON the first colour edit collapses the L/R visual distinction — see R1. Default OFF preserves today's behaviour exactly, at the price of the dead default form. Cheap to flip either way — one line.

Plan + ledger created (owner req 2026-07-15): move the overall-wave gear from the track graphics area into the group's title bar; it opens a NEW two-pane dialog — narrow tab list left («Оба канала»/«Левый»/«Правый»), wide settings pane centre, settings apply per the active tab. Inventory (verified): today SF27 renders a per-track gear inside each overall-wave track (WaveformView.vue:35-45), one per channel, each opening the small single-column SF27 dialog (TracksPanel.vue:702-733) for ITS channel; the destination title bar is the GT11.10 fold header (TracksPanel.vue:348-380, title flex:1 so a right-edge button needs no CSS surgery); the exact two-pane dialog shape already exists as the GT10.29 settings dialog (AudioPage.vue:49-86) and is reused. Constraints found: the gear cannot be DELETED from WaveformView (gtrack lane sublanes reuse it for per-lane settings -> prop showSettingsGear, default true, WS-D6); in overlay mode the wave stack/title bar does not exist and the spectrogram's own gear is the only entry point -> it stays and opens the new dialog on its channel's tab (WS-D5). Side-find: AudioPage.vue:1006-1263 still carries a dead pre-extraction DUPLICATE of the whole waveform-prefs state writing the same localStorage key — harmless today (nothing mutates it), proposed as optional cleanup WS2.1. Decisions WS-D1..D8 proposed; implementation not started — owner review of the plan, then WS1.1.
